evidence: Repository source reads and edits only; no builds, tests, syntax checks, helper/project/game execution or Bedrock launch

reference.speeds: mod/core ReplayViewer.SPEEDS = {0.25,0.5,1,2,4,8,16}; speedUp/speedDown select adjacent bounded indices
reference.frameCap: ReplayViewer.MAX_FRAME_MS = 250; frame caps monotonic real elapsed milliseconds before multiplying by selected replay speed
reference.cameraTime: ReplayViewer retains its normal playhead as double and passes it to CameraPath.at; flooring the packet receipt timestamp is not the camera sampling rule
reference.nativeClock: Java ReplayViewer also updates ReplayClock.scale. Matching native Bedrock simulation scaling is separate from protocol-helper packet/camera scheduling.

port.range: Rust playback admission and both helper configuration/live speed commands accept finite 0.1..16; the older continuous 0.1 minimum remains accepted
port.editor: Shared speed controls in the connection form and active replay editor provide the seven Java steps via Slower/Faster. Existing numeric adjustment remains. A non-preset value steps to the next preset strictly in the requested direction; endpoint buttons disable when no such preset exists.
port.timeline: Normal helper playback clamps max(0, now-previous) to 250ms before speed multiplication. Its existing bounded packet queues, initialization/resource-pack waits and duration bound remain. Indexed export steps retain their explicit rational clock and do not use this real-time cap.
port.cameraSampling: Normal camera sampling and viewer cameraTarget retain fractional elapsed time, independently of the floor used for packet position receipts. An explicitly supplied indexed-export cameraTime still takes precedence; its exact rational conversion and path checks remain unchanged.
port.bounds: No automatic client launch, game input, native timer write or change to an existing speed setting is introduced by source editing

remaining: Runtime validation of launcher/CLI integration, native simulation/animation clock scaling and pause fidelity; native rate and coordinator source paths now exist
